# HyperPay reference

Generated from source. Intro: [README.md](../README.md). Agent map: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

The SDK builds, signs, and submits the hyperpay program. There is no hosted payments API.

## Program

- Id: `Adyo1eYuP8deoLxwgkvaomUYvAUKUGryh4RGpdTR9YhU`
- Source: [`programs/hyperpay`](../programs/hyperpay)

### Instructions

- `ping`
- `init_user`
- `delegate_user`
- `deposit`
- `open_session`
- `charge`
- `close_session`
- `withdraw`
- `ensure_user_mint`

`ping` is a health check. `ensure_user_mint` is used by `topUp`, not as a standalone SDK method.

### Accounts

- `User`
- `UserMint`
- `Session`

`User.authority` is the wallet. Tokens sit in an eSPL eATA owned by the User PDA. `UserMint.reserved` plus `Session.remaining` isolate merchants.

### Errors

- `AmountZero`
- `InsufficientAvailable`
- `InsufficientRemaining`
- `SessionAlreadyOpen`
- `Unauthorized`
- `UserNotDelegated`
- `Overflow`

## TypeScript `HyperPay`

Source: [`packages/core/src/client.ts`](../packages/core/src/client.ts)

| Method | Notes |
|---|---|
| `fromEnv` | static — local — Builds a client from environment variables: `HYPERPAY_KEY`, `HYPERPAY_CLUSTER`, `HYPERPAY_RPC`, `HYPERPAY_EPHEMERAL_RPC`, `HYPERPAY_TOKEN`, plus the policy vars read by `Policy.fromEnv`. |
| `resolveAmount` | async — local — Resolves `"10 USDC"` (or `"10"` + `tokenSpec`) into a concrete token and base units. `openSession` may pass `{ allowZero: true }` so a session can be created empty. |
| `sessionAccounts` | local — User PDA accounts for a wallet authority — never derived from a session-key signer. |
| `initUser` | async — base — Creates the User PDA on the base cluster and funds it with lamports. |
| `delegateUser` | async — base — Delegates the User PDA to the ephemeral rollup (MagicBlock CPI on base). |
| `topUp` | async — base + ephemeral — Deposits tokens from the signer's Tokenkeg ATA into the User eATA (base), then creates the ephemeral UserMint if it is missing. `reserved` stays 0 until `openSession` / `deposit`. Requires `initUser` + `delegateUser`. |
| `openSession` | async — ephemeral — Opens a session with `merchant`. Amount may be 0. |
| `deposit` | async — ephemeral — Reserves more of the user eATA into an existing session. |
| `charge` | async — ephemeral — Debit the user's ER session. Signs with the merchant key. |
| `closeSession` | async — ephemeral — Unreserves remaining and closes the session. User-only. |
| `withdraw` | async — ephemeral — Moves unreserved eATA tokens to `destination`'s eATA (defaults to the signer). |
| `sessionBalance` | async — ephemeral — Remaining units on the ER session between `user` (wallet) and this merchant. |
| `quote` | async — local — Policy-check and resolve an amount without submitting. |
| `balance` | async — base — Base-layer ATA balance for a wallet. |
| `explorerUrl` | local |

SDK-only (not 1:1 program instructions): `fromEnv`, `resolveAmount`, `sessionAccounts`, `topUp`, `sessionBalance`, `quote`, `balance`, `explorerUrl`.

Typical flow: `initUser` → `delegateUser` → `topUp` → `openSession(merchant, amount)` → merchant `charge` → `closeSession` → `withdraw`.

`fromEnv()` and `{ key }` are Node-only. In the browser, pass `{ signer }`. When the signer is a session key, pass `authority` (the wallet that owns the User PDA). Never pass a user's session token to a merchant `charge`.

## Environment

Read by `HyperPay.fromEnv` / `Policy.fromEnv`:

- `HYPERPAY_ALLOW`
- `HYPERPAY_CLUSTER`
- `HYPERPAY_DAILY_CAP`
- `HYPERPAY_DENY`
- `HYPERPAY_EPHEMERAL_RPC`
- `HYPERPAY_JOURNAL`
- `HYPERPAY_KEY`
- `HYPERPAY_MAX_PER_TX`
- `HYPERPAY_RPC`
- `HYPERPAY_TOKEN`
- `HYPERPAY_TOKENS`

Rust example only:

- `HYPERPAY_AUTHORITY`

Caps fail closed: a USDC cap refuses a USDT payment. Deny is checked before allow. Daily spend journals to `HYPERPAY_JOURNAL` (default `~/.hyperpay/spend.json`).

## SDK errors

All extend `HyperPayError`. `PolicyError` means nothing was signed.

- `HyperPayError`
- `PolicyError`
- `ApiError`
- `ConfirmationError`
- `ResolutionError`
- `SignerError`

There is no `pay()`, `InsufficientFundsError`, `HYPERPAY_API`, or hosted Payments API.
